title Pasadizo - the underground passage: hollow footsteps on stone (left, right, each with a fainter echo that comes back off the walls), a bare open fifth humming in the dark, a worried little motif in D minor, a far clank
tempo 80
vol 220
meter 4/4
inst stepl drum=g4 v=255,170,100 d=0,-25,-50
inst stepr drum=e4 v=255,170,100 d=0,-25,-50
inst echl drum=g4 v=80,50,25 d=0,-25,-50
inst echr drum=e4 v=80,50,25 d=0,-25,-50
inst hum arp=0,7 rate=10 att=12 lvl=0.6 slow
inst worry v=255,215,175,150,135
inst clank drum=a6 v=255,225,195,165,135,105,75,50 d=0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 slow
inst clke drum=a6 v=90,75,60,45,30,15 d=0,0,0,0,0,0 slow
# a beat is 75 ticks: the step (3), 22 ticks of silence, the echo (3), the rest
# --- 1-2: footsteps alone, eight beats
[ !stepl=3 r=22 !echl=3 r=47 !stepr=3 r=22 !echr=3 r=47 ]4
# --- 3: the open fifth hums (D, A), then a clank far away and its echo
@hum o4 d2
!clank=16 r=40 !clke=12 r=82
# --- 4: the worried motif (D E F E, D)
@worry o5 d4 e4 f4 e4
@worry o5 d2 r2
# --- 5-6: footsteps again
[ !stepl=3 r=22 !echl=3 r=47 !stepr=3 r=22 !echr=3 r=47 ]4
# --- 7: the hum a step down (C), nothing else
@hum o4 c2 r2
# --- 8: the motif answered (F, E, D, and a half step to C sharp that never resolves)
@worry o5 f4 e4 d4 c+4
@worry o5 d2 r2
